title: Session Deck IA mapping for multi-tenant navigation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Replace the current monolithic left rail with a session-aware, compact 'Session Deck' that surfaces workspace context, active routes, and cost/latency lenses. The goal is to reduce deep navigation steps for multi-tenant users while keeping steady-state visual weight low. This ticket delivers a high-fidelity prototype, acceptance criteria, interaction spec, and rollout plan for a canary + telemetry-driven launch. The deck should be responsive, keyboard-first, and support quick workspace pivots without full page reloads. Key constraints: minimal additional network round trips for initial open, compatibility with Dedicated and Private control planes, and ability for engineering to toggle the deck via feature flag.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates deck open/close, session-scoped breadcrumbs, and quick-switch behaviour in desktop and tablet widths
Keyboard navigation: open (K), focus list (J/K), select (Enter), escape to close; focus should be preserved on close
Cost lens present per-route: last 7d avg tokens and 99th latency shown on hover
Interactions require no full-page navigation for workspace pivot in prototype (client-side routing or staged SPA flow)
Design handoff includes component tokens, spacing scale, and accessibility notes (contrast, ARIA labels, focus traps)
Telemetry hooks defined (nav_open_rate, pivot_success_rate, avg_click_depth) and expected thresholds for canary
Engineering feasibility sign-off for SSR fallback and feature-flag gating is attached
design_notes: Session Deck concept: ephemeral panel that attaches to the console top-left; shows session-scoped lanes (recent projects, pinned routes, suggested routes) and a micro-cost lens per item
We intentionally avoid duplicating the full workspace switcher; the deck acts as a lateral quick path for active flows only
Prototype uses a 3-column micro-layout: icon + title, micro-tags (env, tier), mini-lens (tokens/latency). Hover expands to surface full route metrics
Accessibility: the deck traps focus while open and returns focus to the invoking element; uses ARIA role='dialog' with labelledby header
Performance trade-off: initial render uses cached workspace list from control-plane snapshot; a refresh button revalidates via background fetch to satisfy Dedicated/Private constraints
Cost/quality trade-off: micro-cost lens shows aggregated token count and p50 latency to avoid heavy queries to cost pipeline on every hover. Full drill-down links to Cost view panel
decisions: Adopt 'Session Deck' (ephemeral) instead of replacing left rail to minimize risk to users who prefer persistent nav
Show derived cost metrics (7d aggregate) in deck rather than live per-request cost to limit backend load
Implement client-side routing for workspace pivot to maintain smooth UX; SSR fallback retained for direct URL navigation
Expose feature behind 'deck_nav' feature flag with rollout controls in Console (canary user list + percentage)
